title: Profiling individual through inferred health conditions
description: The app analyzes user data to infer eating-disorder or diabetes risk signals, creating profiles that link data to specific individuals through pattern analysis.
assumptions: The app has access to sufficient historical data to make these inferences

title: Quasi-identifier combination through health indicators
description: Health condition indicators (eating-disorder or diabetes risk signals) combined with other user attributes could serve as quasi-identifiers that link data to specific individuals.
assumptions: Health indicators are combined with other user data

title: Revealing health attributes disclosed to user
description: The dashboard displays revealing health attributes (eating-disorder or diabetes risk signals) that can identify the data subject's health status.
assumptions: Health indicators are displayed directly to the user

title: Processing of identified health data
description: The system processes identified personal data about the user's health conditions and risk indicators.
assumptions: User data is identified and processed for dashboard display

title: Sensitive health data type disclosure
description: Health-related data (eating-disorder or diabetes risk signals) is highly sensitive and may be collected/processed beyond what is strictly required for basic app functionality.
assumptions: Health data is processed for risk inference and display

title: Unnecessary data analysis and enrichment
description: The app performs analysis and inference on health data to generate risk signals, which may constitute processing beyond what is functionally necessary.
assumptions: Inference algorithms are used to derive health risk indicators

title: User unawareness of health data processing
description: Users may not be fully aware of how their health data is being analyzed, what inferences are being made, or how risk signals are derived.
assumptions: Privacy notices may not fully explain inference mechanisms

title: Lack of user control over health data preferences
description: Users may lack control over how their health data is processed, what inferences are made, or how risk indicators are displayed.
assumptions: Limited user preferences for health data processing

title: Potential violation of data minimization principle
description: Processing health data for risk inference may exceed what is actually needed for the app's functional goals, potentially violating data minimization requirements.
assumptions: Health data processing extends beyond core app functionality
